build: Game/Packaged/Hokej_Hokej_H19 (Shipping, main a6b6f5b), 1080p windowed, one game at a time
how: Shipping build, one launch per cell: the 11 shipped non-test cuts at their own look tier (all l2_night) plus hockey.regular and hockey.boost at l1_day, l3_neon, p3_clay and p4_broadcast (a cartridge copy with game.look.tier changed, passed as -cut=<path>; the cut is the shipped one otherwise). 14 launches of about 40 s: card (MATCH 1 card 3 s after ENTER), faceoff (7 s after ENTER), far net from the end boards (W held until the skater stands at the far goal line), pause (ESC), Director's Call (DOWN, ENTER). Six more launches for the menu screens (main, cuts, direct, friend, settings, credits). Keys reach the game by PostMessage because a foreign Windows Security dialog held the foreground all night. Not in this grid: the goal moment and a carry, which need the scripted human (Development package, next section when it ran). Goal moment: Development package (A54-dev, same source) with the scripted human (jam.ScriptHuman=1), still taken 0.8 s after the JAMEVENT goal log line, 150 s per cut at its own tier: only 2 of 11 cuts (hockey.arena.large, hockey.raw) scored in that time, so 2 goal stills.
